anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
I'm using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace. The caller passed resolved PR values, so I follow `reference/pr-head.md` instead of Steps 0 and 1. The process cwd stays at the primary.

## Resolve and preflight (cwd unchanged)

1. `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir` resolves both to `/work/widget/.git`, so `ROOT=/work/widget`.
2. `git -C /work/widget rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` prints nothing, so this is not a submodule.
3. Admitted list: home #12 `fix/retry` @ `aaaaaaa`. `MEMBER_HEADS` holds #13 `fix/cap` @ `bbbbbbb` and #14 `fix/docs` @ `ccccccc`.
   - `SYNC=rebase` and `PRE_REWORK_HEAD=aaaa…aaaa`.
   - `NAME=fix-retry`. No overrides, wrapper or native tool exist, so `WORKTREE=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`.
4. `git -C /work/widget fetch origin` succeeds.
5. For each PR, `git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q <oid>^{commit}` and `git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/<headRefName>` both match `aaaa…`, `bbbb…` and `cccc…`.
6. `BASE_SHA=$(git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/main)` gives `dddd…dddd`.
7. Stop checks, in order, all pass:
   - Every PR is same-repo.
   - `git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain` shows no `fix/retry` checkout.
   - All heads are reachable and equal to their remotes.
   - No local branch exists.
8. Recovery check:
   - `git -C /work/widget show-ref --verify refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12` finds no ref.
   - No local branch or worktree exists, so this is not a recovery.
9. Clean-base check: `git -C /work/widget status --porcelain` exits 0 with empty output, so the source is clean.
10. `git -C /work/widget symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` prints nothing. The default branch is unresolved, so the provenance note is skipped.

## Provision

11. `git -C /work/widget check-ignore -q .worktrees` exits 0, so `.worktrees` is already ignored.
12. `git -C /work/widget worktree add "/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry" fix/retry` succeeds. Unique-remote DWIM tracks `origin/fix/retry`.
13. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD` prints `aaaa…aaaa`, matching the home head.
14. Pre-rework refs, each run with `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`, all succeed:
    - `update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12 aaaa…`
    - `update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-13 bbbb…`
    - `update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-14 cccc…`

## Sync (rebase)

15. Saved last-good is `aaaa…aaaa`.
16. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rebase --no-rebase-merges origin/main` stops on a conflict.
17. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry status --porcelain` is snapshotted.
18. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` lists `src/retry.ts`.
19. Overrides are read from the base, not from the conflicted tree: `git -C /work/widget show dddd…dddd:<first-found overrides path>`.
    - Its `## PR gate` defines a file-scoped runner `node --test <files>` with `requires credentials: false`.
    - `SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS` is therefore `node --test test/retry.test.mjs`.
    - The base-SHA constraints stay authoritative.
20. I dispatch one fresh foreground `implementer` with:
    - `cwd: /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry` and `async: false`
    - the file list `src/retry.ts`, the fetched base `origin/main` @ `ddddddd`, and the scoped command
    - the output of `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rebase --show-current-patch`

    The helper is forbidden from committing and from running `rebase --continue`, `rebase --abort` or `rebase --skip`.
21. The helper returns `done`.
22. Completion check: `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` still lists `src/retry.ts`. The unmerged index is not empty, so the completion check **fails** and I do not run `rebase --continue`.

## Abort and prove restoration

23. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rebase --abort` exits **0**. This was the home rebase, so no member checkout is needed.
24. Each restoration assertion passes:
    - `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD` prints `aaaa…aaaa`, equal to the saved last-good.
    - `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry branch --show-current` prints `fix/retry`, equal to the home branch.
    - `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` exits 0 with empty output, so the tree is clean.
25. Outcome validation for an aborted home rebase: HEAD equals the saved pre-attempt home tip `aaaa…aaaa`. This passes.
26. Records:
    - `sync: unresolved - src/retry.ts`
    - `Member replay: #13 pending`
    - `Member replay: #14 pending`
27. I write no `refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12` and start no member replay.

## Step 4 report

```
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#12
Pre-rework head: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#13
Pre-rework head: bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
PR: acme/widget#14
Pre-rework head: cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
Base SHA: ddddddd
Base: main @ ddddddd - sync: unresolved - src/retry.ts
Member replay: #13 pending
Member replay: #14 pending
Ready to implement rework of #12 (+#13, #14)
```

The report has no `Rework base:` line. `MEMBER_HEADS` is carried to gather.

**Design Task 1** (opens the spec's Design): `rebase onto origin/main and resolve src/retry.ts`. The task has two further requirements:
- It must then complete the pending replays in listed order: #13, then #14. Each replay is `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rebase --no-rebase-merges --onto HEAD dddd…dddd <member oid>`, followed by `update-ref refs/heads/fix/retry HEAD` and `checkout fix/retry`.
- Before finishing, it must persist the durable record with `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry update-ref refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12 HEAD`.

---

## Variant: restore failure

Steps 1–22 are identical. At step 23, `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rebase --abort` exits **1**. The restoration checks then observe:

- `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry branch --show-current` prints `""` (empty output).
- `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD` prints `""` (empty output).
- `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` prints `UU src/retry.ts`.

The abort exit code is not 0 and the status shows a residual path, so I **stop**:

> Restore failed for PR #12 (home rebase onto origin/main). Conflicted files: `src/retry.ts`. Worktree: `/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`. Observed `branch --show-current`: `""`. Observed `rev-parse HEAD`: `""`. `rebase --abort` exit status: 1. Remaining status: `UU src/retry.ts`. Saved last-good: `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`. Members merged/replayed: none. Manual recovery is required in that worktree before rerunning the same list.

In the variant:
- I do not run reset, clean or branch deletion.
- I make no restoration claim.
- I record no `sync: unresolved` continuation and write no Design, spec, rework-base or member replay.
- I emit no Step 4 report.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
I’m using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace.

The admitted PR values select the PR-head procedure, not generic new-branch creation. All observations below are synthetic; no tools are called.

### 1. Resolve and preflight

Resolved values:

```text
ROOT=/work/widget
WORKTREE=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
NAME=fix-retry
BRANCH=fix/retry
SYNC=rebase
PRE_REWORK_HEAD=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
BASE_SHA=dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
MEMBER_HEADS:
  #13 fix/cap  bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
  #14 fix/docs cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
```

The process cwd remains `/work/widget` throughout. Every shell command below runs with that cwd; `git -C` explicitly selects its repository or worktree.

Commands, in order:

```sh
git -C /work/widget fetch origin
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa^{commit}'
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/retry
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q 'bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb^{commit}'
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/cap
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q 'cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc^{commit}'
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/docs
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/main
git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain
git -C /work/widget for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname)' refs/heads refs/gauntlet
git -C /work/widget status --porcelain
```

Fetch succeeds; every admitted object is reachable and its remote branch equals its original SHA. `origin/main` resolves to `BASE_SHA`. There are no conflicting checkouts, local feature branches, recovery refs, wrappers, overrides, or dirty source files. All PRs are same-repository. Default home resolves to `WORKTREE`.

### 2. Provision and record original heads

Setting up an isolated worktree at `/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry` on branch `fix/retry`.

```sh
git -C /work/widget check-ignore -q .worktrees
git -C /work/widget worktree add /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry fix/retry
git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry branch --show-current
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry status --porcelain
```

The ignore check succeeds. Git checks out the existing remote branch through DWIM. Read-backs verify the selected path, branch `fix/retry`, original home SHA, and clean checkout.

```sh
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12 aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-13 bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-14 cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
```

All writes succeed. Save last-good home SHA as `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`.

### 3. Home rebase fails completion checks

```sh
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rebase --no-rebase-merges origin/main
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry status --porcelain
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rebase --show-current-patch
```

Rebase stops on `src/retry.ts`.

Dispatch one fresh foreground `implementer` with:

```text
cwd: /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
async: false
files: [src/retry.ts]
fetched base: dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
scoped command: node --test test/retry.test.mjs
```

Its payload includes the current patch and authoritative fetched-base constraints. Require preserving both sides’ intent, running exactly the supplied scoped command, and staging the resolved file. Forbid outside-file edits, commits, and rebase continue/abort/skip.

The helper returns `done`. Check:

```sh
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
```

Output still contains `src/retry.ts`. Completion fails: `done` does not override the unmerged index. Do not continue or skip the rebase.

### 4. Abort and prove restoration

```sh
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rebase --abort
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry branch --show-current
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry status --porcelain --untracked-files=all
```

Assertions, before continuation:

- Abort exit status is **0**.
- HEAD is exactly `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`, equal to saved last-good.
- Branch is exactly `fix/retry`.
- Status exits **0**, with empty output.

Restoration is verified. Neither member was attempted.

```text
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#12
Pre-rework head: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#13
Pre-rework head: bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
PR: acme/widget#14
Pre-rework head: cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
Base SHA: ddddddd
sync: unresolved - src/retry.ts
Member replay: #13 pending
Member replay: #14 pending
```

Design Task 1: **rebase onto origin/main and resolve src/retry.ts**. Task 1 must then complete pending member replays in order and persist `refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12` only after successful completion. No successful Rework base is written now.

### Independent restore-failure variant

Replace only the abort outcome: abort exits **1**; inspect HEAD, branch, and full status using the same commands above. HEAD prints `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`; branch prints `fix/retry`; status contains:

```text
UU src/retry.ts
```

**STOP:** PR #12 sync restoration failed at `/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`; conflicted file `src/retry.ts`; abort exit **1**; observed branch `"fix/retry"`; observed HEAD `"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"`; saved last-good `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`; no earlier members merged or replayed. Require manual recovery before rerunning. Do not claim restoration, continue Design, start members, reset, clean, or write Rework base.
